role.hint.roamer: Outnumbered. Dive (2s port-burst), blender (cover + AoE), or trickster (stealth/kite). One damage type.
role.hint.damage: Damage family - power, condi, or hybrid from the conversation.
role.hint.troll: Troll. Stall, don't kill. Evade, port, stealth, speed - live through a blob until the group arrives.
role.hint.support: Support family. Cloud/Zerg: specialists (stab / heal-cleanse / boons). Roam/Havoc: self-reliant - prot, invuln, some fight. Dead support is not support.
role.hint.disable: Disable family - CC, interrupts, boon strip.
role.hint.condi: Condition damage over time - bleed, burn, poison, torment.
role.hint.heal: Dedicated healer. Keeps the group standing rather than adding damage.
role.hint.tank: Holds the boss's attention. Toughness and the aggro stats it keys off.

setup.title: FIRST-TIME SETUP
setup.lang_help: Pick the overlay language. Game data and official names (Deutsch, Español, Français, 简体中文) download once in a later step.
setup.gw2_help: Create an API key at ArenaNet's website. Copy the URL below and paste it in your browser:
setup.gw2_create: Create a 'New Key', name it anything, and select these permissions:
setup.enter_validate: Enter your key and click Validate
setup.ai_intro: Choose an AI provider and enter your API key. The optimizer uses AI for build synergy reasoning.
setup.ai_howto: The addon needs an API key from an AI company. You do not have to pay. Most people make a free OpenRouter or Google account and stay on free models.
setup.ai_pick: Pick OpenRouter or Google below. The URL opens a sign-in page - create a free account if you do not have one, then make a key and paste it here.
setup.gemini_howto: Google AI Studio - free Gemini models with a Google account:
setup.gemini_steps: The page asks you to sign in with Google (Create account if you need one). Then create an API key, pick any project, and copy it. The free tier is enough.
setup.openai_howto: OpenAI - this path usually needs a paid account. OpenRouter or Google are free:
setup.openai_steps: Sign in, click Create new secret key, name it, and copy the key. Billing has to be set up on the OpenAI account.
setup.anthropic_howto: Anthropic - this path usually needs a paid account. OpenRouter or Google are free:
setup.anthropic_steps: Sign in, click Create Key, name it, and copy the key. Billing has to be set up on the Anthropic account.
setup.openrouter_howto: OpenRouter - one key, many models, including free ones:
setup.openrouter_steps: The page asks you to sign in first (Google, GitHub, or email - Sign up if you need an account). Then create a key, name it, and copy it. Skip adding credits: free models work at $0. After setup, leave Free on in Settings.

note.attributes: Power and Condition Damage are damage flavors - not DPS.
note.damage: Strike (Power) or condition ticks. The scenario is the target's boons and conditions, not your attributes.
note.modifiers: Stacked from traits, runes, sigils, relics, and skills - already inside the damage numbers. Duration is the part shown separately.
note.boons: Application on you or allies. Strip and conversion on enemies are not scored yet.
note.no_boons: No boon uptime in this rotation.

setup.gemini_next: Click 'Create API key', select any project, and copy the key.
setup.openai_help: Get an OpenAI API key from the OpenAI platform:
setup.openai_next: Click 'Create new secret key', name it, and copy the key.
setup.anthropic_help: Get an Anthropic API key from the Anthropic console:
setup.anthropic_next: Click 'Create Key', name it, and copy the key.
setup.openrouter_help: Get an OpenRouter API key (one key, hundreds of models):
setup.openrouter_next: Click 'Create Key', name it, and copy the key. You can pre-load credits at openrouter.ai/credits.
note.how_to_play: How to play (advisory - scores are the authority).
note.conditions_full: Application on the target. Cleanse removes them. Incoming strike reduction (Protection) is the mitigation we score; Resistance is not.
note.rotation_sim: Simulated - not a live combat log.
note.rotation_model: Not a live combat log - model of this template.
tier.squad: Full Squad (Might x25, Fury, Vuln x25)
note.condi_ticks: Condition ticks (how condi damage applies, Solo)
quality.verified_tip: All input data is source-backed and verified.
quality.provisional_tip: Some data is estimated or provisional. Results are usable but less certain.
quality.blocked_tip: Critical data is missing. Results may not be reliable.

bench.is_reference: This tab is the {site} published reference build ({role}). Your own builds are measured against references like this one.
bench.no_scorable: No published build could be scored in this scenario.
bench.basis: Scores measure how well each build serves your chosen role under your weights, in the same simulator. Reference {ref}, yours {ours}.
bench.basis_role: Scores measure how well each build serves your chosen role ({role_hint}) under your weights, in the same simulator. Reference {ref}, yours {ours}.

bench.other_role: No {role_hint} reference is published for this profession; the closest build is a {role} build scored under your weights.
bench.other_role_title: Different role: not a like-for-like comparison
note.nonviable: Build scored -1.0 (non-viable). It won't rank against viable builds.
err.rate_limited: Rate limited. Wait a minute or switch model.
err.billing: Billing or quota issue on this provider. Check the account or switch provider.
err.timeout: Request timed out. Try a larger/faster model.
err.minute_quota: This model's tier allows only a few requests per minute. Choya now paces itself to it; retry in a minute.
err.daily_quota: This model's daily quota is used up. Pick another model or wait for the reset.
err.upstream_busy: This model's provider is throttling everyone right now, not you. Retry in a minute or pick another model.
err.data_policy: Your OpenRouter workspace guardrail excludes this model's provider (free models that train on prompts). Allow it under Data Training at openrouter.ai/workspaces/default/guardrails, or pick another model.
choya.fallback_reference: Choya could not get an answer from the model. This is the optimizer's own build for what you asked, checked by the referee:

explain.duration_extends: {status} duration bonus extends {status} ticks for more damage.
explain.duration_benefits: Existing {status} application benefits from added duration bonus.
